newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 750 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 750 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 750 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank allotted 707 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 27 and 43 million stg in repos to May 27.
It revised its money market shortage forecast to 1.75 billion stg and has now provided liquidity totalling 1.6 billion stg so far on Friday.
